value.text: Sources at Capcom have confirmed the release date for the highly anticipated GameCube-exclusive Resident Evil 4. Although some online retailers have altered their release dates to reflect the title might ship as late as March 2005, the official word from Capcom today is that Resident Evil 4 will be released on January 11, 2005. Despite missing the 2004 holiday season, the newly announced release date stays within the winter time frame targeted by Capcom some time ago. So speculation can finally be put to rest as GameCube owners and Resident Evil fans can look forward to the super scary, and hopefully amazing addition to the RE franchise which is now due out early next year.

value.text: Capcom confirmed that it will release Resident Evil (Biohazard in Japan) on two discs for 6800 yen (about $50) on March 22, 2002.

Apr 30, 2002 9:00 am - Capcom Entertainment announced today that it has shipped the GameCube remake of Resident Evil to retailers across the US. The game will be available in some parts this afternoon, and in others tomorrow or the day after.
Resident Evil is launching on the GameCube on Friday, September 13th [2002.] [...] it's taken only four months since its US release for [it] to materialise in Europe

More Resident Evil is on the way for Wii owners over in Japan. Famitsu reveals that a port of the GameCube remake of the original RE is being prepared for a big December 25 [2008] release in Capcom's home country.

Capcom has said that Resident Evil Archives - the Wii remake of the first Resident Evil game - will be released in Europe this June. […] The game is out on 23rd June in the US, so expect it around then
Release date: 26 June 2009

Lemony Snicket's A Series of Unfortunate Events is a video game based on the Lemony Snicket book series and film, released by Activision in 2004 for the GameCube, PlayStation 2, Xbox, PC and Game Boy Advance platforms.
